combo_label: Moving House × Butterflies & Moths × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: Corrugated containers taped along the base and filled with books and pans
Gas or electricity box whose figures you jot down on your last morning
Giving up possession of a home to its new occupier at the end of a sale
Naval rank borrowed by the red-banded butterfly that arrives from Europe
Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
Heraldic white fur, and also a white moth freckled all over with black
Hard silcrete boulder from West Woods near Marlborough, dressed into the outer ring
Red deer digging tool, left in the earthwork, that levered out the chalk
Emptied of furniture and people, as a home should be on completion day
Whoever puts the board up outside and takes a cut of the sale price
Sealed, motionless stage in which a grub reorganises into an adult insect
Bold false stare on a wing, there to startle a hungry bird into hesitating
Broad Salisbury upland of chalk, shared by the stones and the army
